title: Legacy of Not Dying to Wolves
description: A balance and bug-fix hack for the first Legacy of Goku. Enemies deal a fraction of their original damage, flight regenerates while on the ground, level-up stats grow more gradually, attacks can no longer do zero damage, and the bug that let attacks heal and overflow a target's health is fixed. Raditz, Vegeta and Ginyu have more health. Distributed as IPS patches with assembly source.
